intro: Grab the family. Bring a date. Challenge your friends. Or finally settle the question of who takes mini golf way too seriously.

highlights.title: No tee time
highlights.text: Walk up, grab a putter and go. That's the whole process.

highlights.title: No handicap
highlights.text: Nobody's checking. Although somebody in your group will absolutely keep score.

highlights.title: No experience required
highlights.text: If you can hold a putter, you're qualified. If you can't, we'll show you.

good_to_know: Putters in every size, including the small ones.
Stroller and wheelchair friendly paths on most of the course.
Food and drinks are steps away, and yes, you can bring them along.
Great add-on for birthday parties and group outings.
